title: Oedipus fulfills the prophecy by fleeing it

tellings.quote: there's this prophecy that this young prince of Thieves is going to grow up and murder his father and marry his mother

plain: In the old Greek story, a prophecy says that a young prince of Thebes will grow up to kill his father and marry his mother, and in running from that fate he makes it come true. The writer Eric Wargo, who studies dreams that seem to foresee the future, retells it to Michels and points to Sigmund Freud, the founder of psychoanalysis, as a reader of the tale, to show how a vision of the future can bring itself about.
